outcome: Postoperative wound infections (Surgical Site Infections - SSIs)
cohort: The study included 220 patients who underwent either elective or emergency cesarean sections.
finding: Rural residence, hypertension, membrane rupture, general anesthesia, blood loss >=500 ml, and low postoperative hemoglobin levels were identified as significant independent predictors for the incidence of surgical site infections (SSIs).
mod_finding: No significant difference in the risk of surgical site infections was observed between emergency and elective cesarean sections.
